items.title: JB said he wants to play Cade and Daniss Jenkins together in the preseason finale, and give Javonte Green and Taurean Prince more run.
items.author: Omari Sankofa II
items.body_excerpt:
JB said he wants to play Cade and Daniss Jenkins together in the preseason finale, and give Javonte Green and Taurean Prince more run. 

On Duren shooting 3s, JB said he has a deal with him where he’ll be allowed to if he holds up his end.

items.title: Javonte Green says it means a lot to him to be able to return. "Coming here, going into the locker room, everyone welcomed you with open arms and it felt like home. It didn't take long for me to bring my energy and personality out because it felt like I was supposed to be here.
